name: Nord

provenance.bg.base: spec: nord0 = background and area coloring
provenance.bg.inset: choice: Nord has no tone below nord0; chrome bands use statusbar.bg = nord1 (spec)
provenance.bg.surface: spec: nord1 = panels, modals, floating popups, form components
provenance.bg.raised: spec: nord2 = active line, selection and text highlighting
provenance.bg.overlay: spec: nord1 = modals and floating popups
provenance.bg.stripe: derived: bg.base darkened to 1.06:1 (weakest fill; bg.inset is invisible here, 1.00:1 vs inactive selection 1.24:1) - zebra rules in layout-archetypes §2.4
provenance.fg.muted: choice: no Nord grey between nord3 (1.69:1) and nord4; derived: nord4 @alpha over nord0 (Textual $foreground-muted convention), alpha raised until >= 4.5:1 [blend(nord4, nord0, 0.65)]
provenance.fg.faint: spec: nord3 = comments, guides, disabled UI
provenance.fg.on-accent: consensus: selection.fg on nord8 = nord0 (1/3); cross-scheme N1 on chromatic fills
provenance.fg.title: spec: nord6 = 'elevated UI text elements that require more visual attention'
provenance.border.default: spec: nord3 = indent/wrap guides; choice over nord1 (spec 'borders') because nord1 is 1.24:1 on nord0
provenance.border.focus: spec: nord8 = primary UI accent; consensus focused border nord8 1/3
provenance.accent.primary: spec: nord8 = 'bright and shiny primary accent color'
provenance.selection.bg: spec: nord2 = selection and text highlighting
provenance.text-selection.bg: spec: nord2 = selection and text highlighting
provenance.cursor.bg: spec: nord4 = UI text editor caret
provenance.status.info: consensus: info = nord8 (1/1); cross-scheme info = cyan

notes: No official kitty port; terminal from nordtheme/alacritty. selection_foreground is dynamic (CellForeground) -> null. Bright cyan is nord7, normal cyan nord8.
nord3 (comments, disabled UI) is 1.69:1 on nord0: fg.faint fails 3:1 and the palette has no compliant grey with that role. Use fg.muted for anything the user must read.
nord11 (errors) is 3.05:1 on nord0 and nord12 is 4.39:1: status.error fails 4.5:1 with no compliant same-role alternative. Pair errors with a glyph and bold.

ansi16 overrides (hue-aware nearest slot that clears the contract floor; dim modelled as 55% blend): accent.primary -> '6' (slot 6 is the closer match to #88c0d0; slot 6 = #88c0d0, 6.24:1) | border.focus -> '6' (slot 6 is the closer match to #88c0d0; slot 6 = #88c0d0, 6.24:1) | keyhint.key -> '6' (slot 6 is the closer match to #88c0d0; slot 6 = #88c0d0, 6.24:1) | link -> '6 underline' (slot 6 is the closer match to #88c0d0; slot 6 = #88c0d0, 6.24:1) | accent.secondary -> '4' (slot 5 #b48ead is not the #81a1c1 hue; slot 4 = #81a1c1, 4.64:1) | mark -> '4' (slot 5 #b48ead is not the #81a1c1 hue; slot 4 = #81a1c1, 4.64:1) | tab.active.fg -> '6 bold' (slot 6 is the closer match to #88c0d0; slot 6 = #88c0d0, 6.24:1) | diff.changed -> '3' (slot 4 #81a1c1 is not the #ebcb8b hue; slot 3 = #ebcb8b, 8.00:1) | fg.muted -> 'default' (default 'default dim' resolves to 3.99:1; now 9.25:1) | fg.faint -> 'default dim' (default '8' resolves to 1.69:1; now 3.99:1)
